architecture.description: Target architecture for the live image (e.g., amd64, i386, arm64).

bootloaders.description: List of bootloaders to include (e.g., syslinux, grub-pc, grub-efi-amd64, grub-efi-arm64).

components.description: List of Debian components to include (e.g., main, contrib, non-free).

distribution.description: Target Debian distribution codename (e.g., trixie, bookworm, sid).

hooks_chroot.description: List of hook names to run during the chroot stage.

hooks_binary.description: List of hook names to run during the binary stage.

linux_flavours.description: List of Linux kernel flavours to install (e.g., 686-pae, amd64, armmp).

media_name.description: Volume ID/media name for the generated image.

parent_archive_aod.description: Enable APT On Demand (add parent archive to chroot sources).

parent_archive_aof.description: Add parent archive to final live image sources.

parents.description: List of parent archive URIs or sources.

image_type.description: Type of image to generate (e.g., iso-hybrid, tar, hdd, netboot, onie).

archive_areas.description: Apt archive areas to use (e.g., main contrib non-free).
